title: Creative is the targeting now
body: PLACEHOLDER. Meta's delivery system decides who sees an ad by reading the ad itself. Which means the brief is the media plan. Ten variations of one idea is one ad. Three genuinely different ideas is three audiences. I've stopped asking how many versions we need and started asking how many different people we are talking to.

title: How the Dema film was made
body: PLACEHOLDER. Three sessions. Script and structure with Claude, motion built as code in HyperFrames, plates generated in Seedance, captions synced to the voice word by word. No After Effects project file exists for this film. The interesting part isn't speed. It's that every frame can be re-rendered when the message changes.
